title: Range Slice A contract and vertical layout repair
purpose: Implement the smallest useful range repair derived from the component audit.
objective: Make range current values, scale ticks, numeric inputs, and vertical rails behave as explicit subelements before adding broader design controls.
scope_boundary: In scope: Elementor control copy, range wrapper classes, vertical CSS grid contracts, long-value overflow handling, and mechanical verification. Out of scope: custom dual-range engine, selected-track overlay, tick count controls, handle icons, number input visibility controls, and visual final approval.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-006 is done and the plugin worktree is clean.
exit_condition: Range vertical mode has explicit layout states for values/ticks and the plugin passes lint/diff checks.
completion_criteria: Current value labels and scale ticks are named distinctly in code-facing UI copy.
Range markup exposes classes that match enabled subelements.
Vertical CSS does not reserve hidden value or tick rails.
Long numeric labels have overflow handling.
No deferred range controls are implemented in this slice.

phases.title: Copy and state classes
phases.purpose: Clarify Elementor labels and expose wrapper state classes.

phases.title: Vertical CSS contract
phases.purpose: Define grid templates by enabled subelements.

phases.title: Verification
phases.purpose: Run syntax/diff checks and document Guilherme QA boundary.

acceptance_criteria: No plugin source outside range render/style/CSS is changed unless verification proves it necessary.
Guilherme visual QA remains required for final craft approval.
verification: Plugin PHP lint and diff checks pass.
stop_conditions: The slice starts adding broad range customization controls.
Fixing vertical layout requires replacing native range inputs.
